name: DoD SkillBridge
tagline: The single largest pipeline from military service into cybersecurity
story: SkillBridge is the federal program that lets active-duty service members spend their last 180 days in uniform doing an industry internship instead of standard military duty. The list of authorized SkillBridge partners now exceeds 3,000 organizations including every major defense contractor, every Big Tech vendor with a cyber practice, and a long tail of cybersecurity startups eager to hire veterans with clearances. If you are within six months of separation from any branch, this is the most concrete way to get hired into a cleared cybersecurity role with zero gap in your resume.
why_hexworth: Hexworth's Shield, Eye, and Dark Arts houses all have SkillBridge-eligible roles in the partner directory. The combination of an active clearance, military discipline, and Hexworth's house-aligned curriculum is one of the most hireable profiles in the industry.
deadline_note: Rolling: apply 180 days before your separation date. Earlier is better for competitive partners.
eligibility: Final approval from your unit commander
Clearance carried in (or eligible for) the role
paid: Continued military pay and benefits during the internship
